findings.reason: a node reading line 382 alone would key the pin table by machine alone, reintroducing exactly the one-row-per-machine defect the v385 change was made to fix.
findings.text: the sentence "it gains a required machine and from it alone resolves the pin row, the registry, the acquisition read and the geometry reader" contradicts the changed pin-table description at plan.html:294-301 and plan.html:447-451, where a machine's entry holds one row per pinned physical identity and the resolver needs the shot's physical digest to choose among two JT-60SA rows

response_events.reason: Plan v386/v387 (commit d16bc572): the selector resolves the registry, acquisition read and reader from the machine, and the pin row from the machine plus the physical digest of the shot's identity; use sites read the row chosen the same way, and the JT-60SA stamp takes its expected digests from the OP1 row because every frozen JT-60SA shot is OP1.
